## Epigenetic Clos

-   [Biolearn](https://bio-learn.github.io/clocks.html)

### First Generation

Primarily estimate biological age based on DNA methylation patterns, aiming to predict chronological age

-   [Horvath 1 2013](https://genomebiology.biomedcentral.com/articles/10.1186/gb-2013-14-10-r115): pan-tissue Horvath clock (353-CpG clock) using 8,000 samples encompassing 51 different tissueand cell types
-   [Horvath 2 2018](https://www.aging-us.com/article/101508/text): we developed a novel and highly robust DNAm age estimator (based on 391 CpGs) for human fibroblasts, keratinocytes, buccal cells, endothelial cells, lymphoblastoid cells, skin, blood, and saliva samples
-   [Hannum 2013](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S1097276512008933): 71- CpG clock using 656 whole-blood samples
-   [PedBE](https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.1820843116): 94 CpG clock using 1,721 pediatric (0-20y) buccal epithelial cell samples
-   [Lin 2016](https://www.aging-us.com/article/100908/text): 99 CpG clock predicting age using Lothian Birth Cohort

### Second Generation

Second-generation clocks are designed to predict health outcomes, morbidity, and mortality more accurately, often incorporating additional clinical or phenotypic data alongside DNA methylation patterns.

-   [Zhang 2017](https://www.nature.com/articles/ncomms14617): 10 CpG clock for mortality risk
-   [PhenoAge 2018](https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC5940111/): uses standard methods but predicts a composite biological age score 31 based on a linear combination of chronological age and nine clinical parameters associated with mortality risk.
-   [GrimAge1 2019](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC6366976/): Seven DNAm-based estimators of plasma proteins including those of plasminogen activator inhibitor 1 (PAI-1) and growth differentiation factor 15. The resulting predictor of lifespan, DNAm GrimAge (in units of years), is a composite biomarker based on the seven DNAm surrogates and a DNAm-based estimator of smoking pack-years. Adjusting DNAm **GrimAge** for chronological age generated novel measure of epigenetic age acceleration, **AgeAccelGrim**.
-   [GrimAge2 2022](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/pmc/articles/PMC9792204/): Here we describe version 2 of GrimAge (trained on individuals aged between 40 and 92) which leverages two new DNAm based estimators of (log transformed) plasma proteins: high sensitivity C-reactive protein (logCRP) and hemoglobin A1C (logA1C). 13,399 blood samples across nine study cohorts.

### Third Generation

-   [DunedinPoAm38 2022](https://elifesciences.org/articles/54870): Dunedin Study members for whom age-38 DNA methylation data were available (N = 810). We applied elastic-net regression (Zou and Hastie, 2005) using Pace of Aging between ages 26 to 38 years as the criterion.
-   [DunedinPACE 2022](https://elifesciences.org/articles/73420): Improved over PoAM38, longer follow-up, more time points.
-   [CausAge 2024](https://www.nature.com/articles/s43587-023-00557-0): epigenome-wide Mendelian randomization, we identified CpG sites potentially causal for aging-related traits. We established a new framework to introduce causal information into epigenetic clocks, resulting in **DamAge** and **AdaptAge**---clocks that track detrimental and adaptive methylation changes, respectively. DamAge correlates with adverse outcomes, including mortality, while AdaptAge is associated with beneficial adaptations.

## ADNI

### Phenotypes

```{r}
## Clinical
merge.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/ADNIMERGE_25Sep2023.csv")

merge <- dplyr::select(merge.raw, RID, PTID, COLPROT, ORIGPROT, VISCODE, EXAMDATE, EXAMDATE_bl, 
                AGE, PTGENDER, PTEDUCAT, APOE4, PTRACCAT, PTETHCAT,
                DX_bl, DX, CDRSB, ADAS13,
                FDG, PIB, AV45, ABETA, TAU, PTAU, ADAS13, Hippocampus, WholeBrain) %>%
  mutate(
    race = case_when(
      # ptraccat != "Asian" & ptethcat != "Hisp/Latino" & ptraccat != "Black" 
      #  & ptraccat != "White" ~ "Other",
      PTRACCAT == "White" & PTETHCAT != "Hisp/Latino" ~ "NHW",
      PTRACCAT == "White" & PTETHCAT == "Hisp/Latino" ~ "Hispanic",
      PTRACCAT == "More than one" & PTETHCAT == "Hisp/Latino" ~ "Hispanic",
      PTRACCAT == "Black" ~ "Black",
      PTRACCAT == "Asian" ~ "Asian",
      PTRACCAT == "Unknown" ~ "Other",
      PTRACCAT == "Am Indian/Alaskan" ~ "AIAN",
      PTRACCAT == "Hawaiian/Other PI" ~ "NHPI",
      PTRACCAT == "More than one" ~ "SOR",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )) %>% 
  arrange(RID, EXAMDATE) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  mutate(
    years_since_baseline = as.numeric(difftime(EXAMDATE, EXAMDATE_bl, units = "days")) / 365.25,
    age = AGE + years_since_baseline,
    cohort = "ADNI",
    months = case_when(
      VISCODE == "bl" ~ '0', 
      str_detect(VISCODE, "m*") ~ str_replace(VISCODE, "m", "")
    ), 
    months = as.numeric(months), 
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

merge_bl <- merge %>%
  filter(VISCODE == 'bl')
  
dx_lv <- merge %>%
  dplyr::select(RID, VISCODE, EXAMDATE, EXAMDATE_bl, years_since_baseline, age, DX) %>%
  # filter(RID %in% rids$RID) %>% 
  group_by(RID) %>% 
  fill(DX, .direction = "down") %>%
  slice_max(EXAMDATE) %>%
  ungroup() 

dx_lv %>% 
  summarise(
     n = n(),
   age = mean(age), 
    years = mean(years_since_baseline)
  )

csf <- merge %>%
  dplyr::select(RID, VISCODE, EXAMDATE, years_since_baseline, age, ABETA, TAU, PTAU) %>%
  # filter(RID %in% rids$RID) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(ABETA), !is.na(TAU), !is.na(PTAU)) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>% 
  slice_max(EXAMDATE) %>%
  ungroup()

csf %>% 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    age = mean(age), 
    years = mean(years_since_baseline)
  )

fdg <- merge %>%
  dplyr::select(RID, VISCODE, EXAMDATE, years_since_baseline, age, FDG) %>%
  # filter(RID %in% rids$RID) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(FDG)) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>% 
  slice_max(EXAMDATE) %>%
  ungroup()

fdg %>% 
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    age = mean(age), 
    years = mean(years_since_baseline)
  )

av45 <- merge %>%
  dplyr::select(RID, VISCODE, EXAMDATE, years_since_baseline, age, AV45) %>%
  # filter(RID %in% rids$RID) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(AV45)) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>% 
  slice_max(EXAMDATE) %>%
  ungroup()

av45 %>% 
  summarise(
     n = n(),
   age = mean(age), 
    years = mean(years_since_baseline)
  )

brain <- merge %>%
  dplyr::select(RID, EXAMDATE, years_since_baseline, age, WholeBrain, Hippocampus) %>%
  # filter(RID %in% rids$RID) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(WholeBrain), !is.na(Hippocampus)) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>% 
  slice_max(EXAMDATE) %>%
  ungroup()

brain %>% 
  # filter(years_since_baseline > 0) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    age = mean(age), 
    years = mean(years_since_baseline),
  )

```

A total of 649 ADNI participants hadmethylation data. Participants varied on the number of repeatDNA methylation measurements they had: 83 had only abaseline measurement; 121 had 2 measurements (baseline plus 1repeat), mean 14.5 months between measurements (SD = 7.06);407 had 3 measurements, mean 12.1 months between mea-surements (SD = 1.5); 29 had 4, mean 10.4 months betweenmeasurements (SD = 3.54); and 9 had 5, mean 12.5 monthsbetween measurements (SD = 2.25). [Sugden et al 2022](https://www.neurology.org/doi/10.1212/WNL.0000000000200898)

### Methylation

```{r}
## Mythylation
map.raw <- readxl::read_xlsx("resources/ADNI/ADNI_DNA_Methylation_SampleAnnotation_20170530.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(Edate = as.Date(Edate))
clocks.raw <- read_csv("intermediate/adni_epiclocks_240826.csv") %>%
  rename(barcodes = '...1' ) 

dnam.raw <- map.raw %>%
  dplyr::select(barcodes, RID, Phase,  Edate, DateDrawn, PlateNumber, Array) %>%
  rename(Phase_methy = Phase,  Edate_methy = Edate, DateDrawn_methy = DateDrawn) %>%
  arrange(RID, Edate_methy, PlateNumber) %>%
  left_join(clocks.raw, by = 'barcodes') 

dnam <- dnam.raw %>% 
  group_by(RID, Edate_methy) %>%
  distinct(RID, .keep_all = T) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice(1:3)%>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(-Age)

```

### Genetics

```{r}
## Genetics 
gen.raw <- read_csv("resources/ADNI/APOE_GENETIC_27Aug2024.csv") %>%
  arrange(RID, VISDATE) 

apoe_wgs.path <- "resources/ADNI/ADNI.808_indiv.minGQ_21.pass.ADNI_ID.chr19.vcf/apoe_region.vcf"
apoe_wgs.raw <- vcfR::read.vcfR(apoe_wgs.path)

apoe_wgs <- vcfR::vcfR2tidy(apoe_wgs.raw, format_fields = c("GT")) %>%
  magrittr::extract2('gt') %>%
  filter(POS %in% c("45411941", "45412079")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ChromKey, -gt_GT) %>%
  mutate(
    POS = ifelse(POS == 45412079, 'rs7412', 'rs429358'), 
    RID = sub("^0+", "", str_extract(Indiv, "\\d{4}$")), 
    RID = as.numeric(RID)
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = POS, values_from = gt_GT_alleles) %>%
  arrange(RID)
  

semi_join(gen.raw, apoe_wgs, by = c('PTID' = 'Indiv')) 
semi_join(gen.raw, apoe_wgs, by = c('PTID' = 'Indiv')) %>%
  group_by(PTID) %>% slice_max(VISDATE) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  count(PHASE, VISCODE2)
```

### Merge

```{r}

rids <- bind_rows(
  dplyr::select(ts, RID), 
  dplyr::select(dnam, RID)
) %>%
  distinct(RID)


adni.raw <- merge %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(apoe_wgs, -RID), by = c("PTID" = "Indiv")) %>%
  left_join(dnam %>% dplyr::select(-DateDrawn_methy, -Phase_methy),
            by = c('RID', 'EXAMDATE' = 'Edate_methy')) %>%
  left_join(ts %>% dplyr::select(-VISCODE, -VISCODE2, -update_stamp, -DATE_DRAWN, -DATE_RECEIVED, -PHASE), 
            by = c('RID', 'EXAMDATE' = 'EXAM_DATE')) %>%
  semi_join(rids) 
  
adni <- adni.raw %>% 
  filter(!is.na(PlateNumber) | !is.na(PLATE)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-DX) %>%
  full_join(dx_lv %>% dplyr::select(RID, VISCODE, EXAMDATE, EXAMDATE_bl, years_since_baseline, age, DX)) %>%
  arrange(RID, EXAMDATE) %>%
  relocate(DX, .after = DX_bl) %>%
  relocate(age, .after = AGE) %>%
  mutate(
    cohort = "ADNI",
    months = case_when(
      VISCODE == "bl" ~ '0', 
      str_detect(VISCODE, "m*") ~ str_replace(VISCODE, "m", "")
    ), 
    months = as.numeric(months), 
  ) %>%
  relocate(months, .after = VISCODE) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  mutate(
    visit = 1:n(),
    visits = n()
  )  %>%
  relocate(visit, visits, .after = months) %>%
  ungroup()


adni %>% 
  # filter(visits == 3) %>%
  group_by(visit) %>%
  summarise(
    age = mean(age),
    n = n(),
    n_wgs = sum(!is.na(rs7412)),
    n_mth = sum(!is.na(CausAge)),
    n_tel = sum(!is.na(TS_RATIO)), 
    median_age = median(age),
    # iqr = IQR(age)
  ) 

adni_dnam_bl <- adni %>%
  filter(visit == 1) %>%
  filter(!is.na(CausAge))

```

```{r}
ba <- dnam %>% 
  dplyr::select(barcodes, RID, Edate_methy, AGE, DX, CDRSB, Horvathv2, Hannum, Lin, PhenoAge, CausAge, DNAmGrimAgev2) %>%
  group_by(RID) %>%
  slice_min(Edate_methy) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = Horvathv2:DNAmGrimAgev2, 
    names_to = 'clock', 
    values_to = 'ba'
  )


ggplot(ba, aes(x = AGE, y = ba, colour = clock)) + 
  facet_wrap(facets = vars(clock)) + 
  geom_point(color = 'black') + 
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x) + 
  theme_bw()
  
ggplot(ba, aes(x = AGE, y = ba, colour = DX)) + 
  facet_wrap(facets = vars(clock)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x, color = "black") + 
  theme_bw()
  

ggplot(ba, aes(x = CDRSB, y = ba, colour = clock)) + 
  facet_wrap(facets = vars(clock)) + 
  geom_point(color = 'black') + 
  geom_smooth(method='lm', formula= y~x) + 
  theme_bw()

ggplot(dx_lv, aes(x=age, y="ADNI") ) +
  stat_density_2d(aes(fill = ..density..), geom = "raster", contour = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme(
    legend.position='none'
  )

ggplot(adni, aes(x = age, y = cohort, fill = factor(visit))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Age", y = "Cohort", fill = "Visit") +
```

## ROSMAP

### LIBRA Risk score

```{r}
# Dementia risk score 
cog.raw <- readxl::read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/AndrewsLab/data/RUSH/1341/dataset_1341_basic_01-10-2024.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(projid = as.character(projid))
cog_long.raw <- readxl::read_xlsx("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/AndrewsLab/data/RUSH/1341/dataset_1341_long_01-10-2024.xlsx") %>%
  mutate(projid = as.character(projid)) 

adri.raw <- read_csv("~/Dropbox/Research/PhD/Analysis/10 CAPA/(2) Derived Data/RUSH-ADRI.csv") %>%
  dplyr::select(-'...1') %>%
  mutate(projid = as.character(projid))

rf <- cog_long.raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(cogn_global)) %>%
  group_by(projid) %>%
  slice_min(fu_year) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(projid, r_stroke, hypertension_cum) %>%
  left_join(dplyr::select(adri.raw, projid, age_bl, sex, educ, apoe_genotype, pa_risk, bmi, chlstrl, socialnetwork_risk, cogactivity_risk, alcohol_risk, smoke_risk, diabetes_risk, depression_risk, adri), 
            by = 'projid') %>%
  filter(!is.na(educ)) 

  
### impute missing data 
require(doParallel)
registerDoParallel(cores=3) 
getDoParWorkers()
require(doRNG)
registerDoRNG(seed = 333)

rosmap_ximp <- rf %>%
  dplyr::select(-projid) %>%
  mutate(
    r_stroke = as_factor(r_stroke), 
    sex = as_factor(sex), 
    smoke_risk = as_factor(smoke_risk), 
    apoe_genotype = as_factor(apoe_genotype), 
    pa_risk = as_factor(pa_risk), 
    socialnetwork_risk = as_factor(socialnetwork_risk), 
    cogactivity_risk = as_factor(cogactivity_risk), 
    alcohol_risk = as_factor(alcohol_risk), 
    diabetes_risk = as_factor(diabetes_risk), 
    depression_risk = as_factor(depression_risk), 
    hypertension_cum = as_factor(hypertension_cum), 
  ) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  missForest(xmis = ., variablewise = TRUE, verbose = TRUE, xtrue = filter(., complete.cases(.)), parallelize = 'forests')

rosmap_imp <- rosmap_ximp %>%
  magrittr::extract2(1) %>%
  dplyr::select(-age_bl, -sex, -apoe_genotype) %>%
  magrittr::set_colnames(paste0("i_", colnames(.))) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  mutate(
    i_pteducat = round(i_educ), 
    i_bmi = round(i_bmi, 1)
  )

libra <- rf %>%
  bind_cols(rosmap_imp) %>%
  mutate(
    libra_agesex = case_when(
      age_bl <= 64 & sex == 1 ~ 0,
      age_bl > 64 & age_bl <= 69 & sex == 1 ~ 6,
      age_bl > 69 & age_bl <= 74 & sex == 1 ~ 8,
      age_bl > 74 & age_bl <= 79 & sex == 1 ~ 13,
      age_bl > 79 & age_bl <= 84 & sex == 1 ~ 17,
      age_bl > 84 & age_bl <= 89 & sex == 1 ~ 20,
      age_bl > 89 & sex == 1 ~ 22,
      age_bl <= 64 & sex == 0 ~ 0,
      age_bl > 64 & age_bl <= 69 & sex == 0 ~ 4,
      age_bl > 69 & age_bl <= 74 & sex == 0 ~ 7,
      age_bl > 74 & age_bl <= 79 & sex == 0 ~ 11,
      age_bl > 79 & age_bl <= 84 & sex == 0 ~ 15,
      age_bl > 84 & age_bl <= 89 & sex == 0 ~ 19,
      age_bl > 89 & sex == 0 ~ 23,
   ),
    libra_pa = case_when(
      i_pa_risk %in% c(-3, -2) ~ 0, 
      i_pa_risk == 0 ~ 1.1,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    libra_cog = case_when(
      i_cogactivity_risk %in% c(-7, -6) ~ -3.2, 
      i_cogactivity_risk == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    libra_alc = case_when(
      i_alcohol_risk %in% c(-3) ~ -1, 
      i_alcohol_risk == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    libra_smk = case_when(
      i_smoke_risk %in% c(1,4) ~ 1.5, 
      i_smoke_risk == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    libra_stroke = case_when(
      i_r_stroke %in% c(1,2,3) ~ 1, 
      i_r_stroke == 4 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    libra_diab = case_when(
      i_diabetes_risk == 3 ~ 1.3, 
      i_diabetes_risk == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    libra_chl = case_when(
      i_chlstrl >= 239 ~ 1.4, 
      i_chlstrl < 239 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    libra_bmi = case_when(
      i_bmi >= 30 ~ 1.6, 
      i_bmi < 30 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    libra_htn = case_when(
      i_hypertension_cum == 1 ~ 1.6, 
      i_hypertension_cum == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    libra_dep = case_when(
      i_depression_risk == 2 ~ 2.1, 
      i_depression_risk == 0 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),  
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    libra = sum(libra_pa, libra_cog, libra_alc, libra_smk, libra_stroke, libra_diab, 
                libra_chl, libra_bmi, libra_htn, libra_dep, na.rm = F), 
    libra2 = sum(libra_agesex, libra_pa, libra_cog, libra_alc, libra_smk, libra_stroke, libra_diab, 
                libra_chl, libra_bmi, libra_htn, libra_dep, na.rm = F), 
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

rosmap_mcaide <- rf %>%
  bind_cols(rosmap_imp) %>%
  mutate(
    mcaide_age = case_when(
      age_bl <= 64.5 ~ 0, 
      age_bl > 64.5 & age_bl < 73 ~ 1, 
      age_bl >= 73 ~ 2, 
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    mcaide_educ = case_when(
      i_educ <= 11 ~ 2, 
      i_educ >= 12 & i_educ <= 16 ~ 1, 
      i_educ > 16 ~ 0, 
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    mcaide_sex = case_when(
      sex == 1 ~ 1, 
      sex == 0 ~ 0, 
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    mcaide_bmi = case_when(
      i_bmi < 30 ~ 0, 
      i_bmi >= 30 ~ 2, 
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    mcaide_sbp = case_when(
      i_hypertension_cum == 0 ~ 0, 
      i_hypertension_cum == 1 ~ 2, 
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    mcaide_chol = case_when(
      i_chlstrl >= 239 ~ 2, 
      i_chlstrl < 239 ~ 0,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
    mcaide_pa = case_when(
      i_pa_risk %in% c(-3, -2) ~ 0, 
      i_pa_risk == 0 ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ), 
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    mcaide = sum(mcaide_age, mcaide_educ, mcaide_sex, mcaide_bmi, mcaide_sbp, mcaide_chol, mcaide_pa, na.rm = F), 
  ) %>%
  ungroup() 
  
ggplot(libra, aes(x = adri, y = libra)) + geom_point()
```

```{r}

      apoe_genotype	 %in% c(24,34,44) ~ "e4+",

    apoe4 = case_when(
      apoe_genotype %in% c(33, 23, 22) ~ 0,
```

### Mediation Models

```{r}

ExMedRes <- function(med_model, outcome, treat, mediator) {
  # Extract summary from the mediation model
  mediation_summary <- summary(med_model)
  
  # Create a tibble with relevant components
  mediation_results <- tibble(
    term = c("ACME", "ADE", "Total Effect", "Prop. Mediated"),
    estimate = c(mediation_summary$d0, mediation_summary$z0, mediation_summary$tau.coef, mediation_summary$n0),
    conf.low = c(mediation_summary$d0.ci[1], mediation_summary$z0.ci[1], mediation_summary$tau.ci[1], mediation_summary$n0.ci[1]),
    conf.high = c(mediation_summary$d0.ci[2], mediation_summary$z0.ci[2], mediation_summary$tau.ci[2], mediation_summary$n0.ci[2]),
    p.value = c(mediation_summary$d0.p, mediation_summary$z0.p, mediation_summary$tau.p, mediation_summary$n0.p),
    outcome = outcome,        # Add the outcome variable
    treat = treat,            # Add the treatment variable
    mediator = mediator       # Add the mediator variable
  )
  
  return(mediation_results)
}

## mtDNAcn -> path -> cog 
cog_gpath_mtcn.m <- lm(gpath ~ z_mtcn + age_death + msex + apoe + tissue, data = rosmap.cc)
cog_gpath_mtcn.y <- lm(cogng_demog_slope ~ z_mtcn + gpath + age_death + msex + apoe + tissue, data = rosmap.cc)

cog_gpath_mtcn.med <- mediate(cog_gpath_mtcn.m, cog_gpath_mtcn.y, treat = "z_mtcn", mediator = "gpath", boot = T, sims = 5000)
summary(cog_gpath_mtcn.med)
cog_gpath_mtcn.df <- ExMedRes(cog_gpath_mtcn.med, 'cog', 'z_mtcn', 'gpath')

## mtDNAcn  -> DNAm -> cog 
cog_dnam_mtcn.m <- lm(z_dnam ~ z_mtcn + age_death + msex + apoe + tissue, data = rosmap.cc)
cog_dnam_mtcn.y <- lm(cogng_demog_slope ~ z_dnam + z_mtcn + age_death + msex + apoe + tissue, data = rosmap.cc)

cog_dnam_mtcn.med <- mediate(cog_dnam_mtcn.m, cog_dnam_mtcn.y, treat = "z_mtcn", mediator = "z_dnam", boot = T)
summary(cog_dnam_mtcn.med)
cog_dnam_mtcn.df <- ExMedRes(cog_dnam_mtcn.med, 'cog', 'z_mtcn', 'z_dnam')

## Libra -> DNAm -> cog 
cog_dnam_libra.m <- lm(z_dnam ~ libra + age_death + msex + apoe + tissue, data = rosmap.cc)
cog_dnam_libra.y <- lm(cogng_demog_slope ~ z_dnam + libra + age_death + msex + apoe + tissue, data = rosmap.cc)

cog_dnam_libra.med <- mediate(cog_dnam_libra.m, cog_dnam_libra.y, treat = "libra", mediator = "z_dnam", boot = T)
summary(cog_dnam_libra.med)
cog_dnam_libra.df <- ExMedRes(cog_dnam_libra.med, 'cog', 'libra', 'z_dnam')

```

```{r}

sem_cov <- ' 
 # regressions
   cogng_demog_slope ~ gpath + age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue
   cogng_demog_slope ~ z_dnam + age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue
   cogng_demog_slope ~ z_mtcn+ age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue
   gpath ~ z_dnam + age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue
   gpath ~ z_mtcn + age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue
   z_mtcn ~ z_dnam + age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue
   z_dnam ~ libra + age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue
'

sem_cov.res <- sem(model = sem_cov, data = rosmap.df, missing = 'ML') 
summary(sem_cov.res,standardized=TRUE)

```

```{r}
## SEM Mediation Models 

sem_cov_mediation <- '
  # Regression equations
  # Cognitive decline regressed on gpath, z_dnam, z_mtcn, and covariates
    cogng_demog_slope ~ b1*gpath + b2*z_dnam + b3*z_mtcn + b4*age_death + b5*msex + b6*apoe4 + b7*tissue

  # Global AD pathology regressed on z_dnam, z_mtcn, and covariates
    gpath ~ a1*z_dnam + a2*z_mtcn + a3*age_death + a4*msex + a5*apoe4 + a6*tissue

  # mtDNA copy number regressed on z_dnam and covariates
    z_mtcn ~ c1*z_dnam + c2*age_death + c3*msex + c4*apoe4 + c5*tissue

  # DNAm age acceleration regressed on LIBRA score and covariates
    z_dnam ~ d1*libra + d2*age_death + d3*msex + d4*apoe4 + d5*tissue

  # Indirect effects
  # Indirect effect of z_dnam on cognitive decline via gpath
    indirect_zdnam_gpath_cog := a1 * b1

  # Indirect effect of z_mtcn on cognitive decline via gpath
    indirect_zmtcn_gpath_cog := a2 * b1

  # Indirect effect of z_dnam on cognitive decline via z_mtcn
    indirect_zdnam_mtcn_cog := c1 * b3

  # Indirect effect of z_dnam on cognitive decline via z_mtcn and gpath
    indirect_zdnam_mtcn_gpath_cog := c1 * a2 * b1

  # Total indirect effect of z_dnam on cognitive decline
    total_indirect_zdnam_cog := indirect_zdnam_gpath_cog + indirect_zdnam_mtcn_cog + indirect_zdnam_mtcn_gpath_cog

  # Total effect of z_dnam on cognitive decline
    total_effect_zdnam_cog := b2 + total_indirect_zdnam_cog

'

semMedi.fit <- sem(model = sem_cov_mediation, data = rosmap.df, missing = 'ML') 
summary(semMedi.fit,standardized=TRUE, fit=TRUE )

semPlot::semPaths(fit, whatLabels = "std", edge.label.cex = .5, layout = "tree2", rotation = 2, style = "lisrel", intercepts = FALSE, residuals = TRUE, curve = 1, curvature = 3, nCharNodes = 8, sizeMan = 6, sizeMan2 = 3, optimizeLatRes = TRUE, edge.color = "#000000")
```

```{r}
sem.out <- standardizedSolution(semMedi.fit) %>%
  filter(op == "~") %>%
  # filter(rhs %in% c('z_dnam', 'z_mtcn', 'gpath', 'libra')) %>%
    mutate(
    signif = gtools::stars.pval(pvalue), 
    est.std = round(est.std, 2), 
    ci.lower = round(ci.lower, 3), 
    ci.upper = round(ci.upper, 3), 
    pvalue = round(pvalue, 3), 
    out = glue::glue("{est.std} ({ci.lower}, {ci.upper}), P = {pvalue}")
   )

write_csv(sem.out, "results/sem_results.csv")
```

```{r}

cog_res <- residuals(lm(cogng_demog_slope ~ age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue, data = rosmap.cc ))
mtcn_res <- residuals(lm(z_mtcn ~ age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue, data = rosmap.cc ))
dnam_res <- residuals(lm(z_dnam ~ age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue, data = rosmap.cc ))
gpath_res <- residuals(lm(gpath ~ age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue, data = rosmap.cc ))
libra_res <- residuals(lm(libra ~ age_death + msex + apoe4 + tissue, data = rosmap.cc ))

sem.df <- tibble(
  cog = cog_res,
  gpath = gpath_res,
  mtcn = mtcn_res,
  dnam = dnam_res,
  libra = libra_res
)

myModel <- ' 
 # regressions
   cog ~ gpath
   cog ~ dnam 
   cog ~ mtcn 
   gpath ~ dnam 
   gpath ~ mtcn 
   mtcn ~ dnam 
   dnam ~ libra 
'

fit <- sem(model = myModel, data = sem.df, missing = 'ML') 
summary(fit,standardized=TRUE)


myModel <- ' 
  # Direct effects
  cog ~ c1*gpath + c2*dnam + c3*mtcn
  gpath ~ b1*dnam + b2*mtcn
  mtcn ~ a1*dnam
  dnam ~ libra

  # Indirect effects (mediation)
  # mtDNAcn to cognitive decline via pathology
  indirect_mtDNAcn_cog := b2*c1

  # DNAM to cognitive decline via mtDNAcn and pathology
  indirect_DNAM_cog := a1*b2*c1 + b1*c1

  # Total effects
  total_mtDNAcn_cog := c3 + b2*c1
  total_DNAM_cog := c2 + a1*b2*c1 + b1*c1
'

# Fit the model with bootstrapping
fit <- sem(model = myModel, data = sem.df, missing = 'ML')

# View the summary, including standardized estimates and bootstrapped standard errors
summary(fit, standardized = TRUE, rsquare = TRUE)

semPlot::semPaths(fit, 
         what = "std",       # Show standardized estimates
         layout = "tree2",    # Tree layout for clearer hierarchy
         style = "lisrel",
         edge.label.cex = 1, # Size of edge labels (path coefficients)
         curve = TRUE,       # Allow curved paths for readability
         fade = FALSE,       # Make paths fully visible (no transparency)
         nCharNodes = 0,     # Show full variable names
         residuals = FALSE,   # Show residual variances
         intercepts = FALSE) # Hide intercepts in the diagram




```
